experiments/star-field/engine/spiral/fill.ts

Deterministic point-cloud fills for galaxies — the math
Source src/experiments/star-field/engine/spiral/fill.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

fillSpiral

Fills the position + color buffers for one spiral galaxy: BULGE fraction of points cluster in the core (tight gaussian), the rest follow ARMS logarithmic arms with angular jitter and a thin vertical gaussian so the disc reads as a real spiral at any tilt. An optional halo fraction peels off the tail of the buffer into a spherical stellar-halo distribution (globular-cluster haze standing in for the oldest populations), and thick multiplies disc thickness for bodies like the Milky Way whose volume must read as a 3-D object from inside.

  • @param pos Float32 xyz buffer — indexes [i0·3, i1·3) are written.
  • @param col Float32 rgb buffer (same range).
  • @param radius Disc radius in scene units.
  • @param seed Body seed — each point draws from its own LCG keyed by
  • @param count Point count to fill.
  • @param arms Spiral arm count.
  • @param thick Disc-thickness multiplier on SF_SPIRAL.THIN.
  • @param halo Fraction (0–1) of points scattered into a spherical halo.
  • @param jitter Arm angular scatter in radians — tight jitters draw
  • @param bubble Optional heliocentric exclusion zone — { x, y, z, r }
  • @param i0 First point index of this range (0 for the local fill).
  • @param i1 One past the last point index (count for the local fill).

fillElliptical

Fills the buffers for an elliptical dwarf galaxy — no spiral structure, just a smooth spheroid of old stars: a gaussian radial profile (dense core, exponential fall-off) over uniform directions, flattened on Y so the smudge reads as a dE/dSph rather than a ball. The tint hex steers the vertex ramp so spheroidals glow warm and irregulars read cooler.

  • @param pos Float32 xyz buffer — indexes [i0·3, i1·3) are written.
  • @param col Float32 rgb buffer (same range).
  • @param radius Body radius in scene units.
  • @param seed Body seed — per-point Fibonacci-hashed LCG (chunkable).
  • @param count Point count to fill.
  • @param tint RGB multiplier tint (from def.color channel components).
  • @param i0 First point index of this range (0 for the local fill).
  • @param i1 One past the last point index (count for the local fill).

fillDust

Fills the dust-lane buffers — the Great Rift. Lanes hug the arm gaps (half an arm period off the star arms) on the same golden-pitch log spiral + sway the star fill uses, so dust traces the actual gaps rather than a parallel-but-different curve. Per-point Fibonacci-hashed seeds keep the fill chunkable across the worker pool.

  • @param pos Float32 xyz buffer — indexes [i0·3, i1·3) are written.
  • @param col Float32 rgb buffer (same range).
  • @param seed Body seed.
  • @param count Dust point count.
  • @param radius Disc radius in scene units.
  • @param arms Spiral arm count.
  • @param i0 First point index of this range.
  • @param i1 One past the last point index.
